title: College Basketball
description:
Bowling Green at Indiana
The Bowling Green Falcons visit the No. 23 Indiana Hoosiers in NCAA Division I Men's Basketball game. Bowling Green defeated Gardner-Webb 91-65 with Makhi Leach, while No. 23 Indiana ride a seven-game win streak with Darren Harris.

title: College Football
description:
Illinois at Northwestern
The Wildcats (6-5, 3-5 Big Ten) host the Fighting Illini (6-5, 4-4) at Ryan Field in Evanston. Illinois seeks to snap a two-game skid after a 34-17 loss to Iowa, while Northwestern aims to end a four-game slide after falling 20-17 to Minnesota.

title: B1G  Football Game Break
description: Our analysts check in on the action all across the B1G as football Saturday continues.

title: College Football
description:
Michigan State at Rutgers
The Rutgers Scarlet Knights (3-8, 2-6 Big Ten) host the Michigan State Spartans (3-8, 1-7) at SHI Stadium in Piscataway. Michigan State seeks to snap a two-game skid after a 45-7 loss to Oregon, while Rutgers beat Penn State 25-24 in Week 12.

title: B1G  Football Postgame
description: Recap the games from around the conference along with postgame sound from coaches and players.

title: College Basketball
description:
California vs. Minnesota
The California Golden Bears (5-2) take on the undefeated Minnesota Golden Gophers (7-0) at Sanford Pentagon. California enters on a three-game win streak after routing Alabama State 96-54, while Minnesota seeks to make it eight straight victories.

title: College Basketball
description:
Lipscomb at Ohio State
The Lipscomb Bisons (4-5) visit the Ohio State Buckeyes (4-3) at Schottenstein Center in Columbus. Lipscomb enters following a 101-66 loss to Auburn, while Ohio State saw its two-game win streak end after falling 72-66 to Vanderbilt.

title: College Basketball
description:
Norfolk State at Washington
The Norfolk State Spartans (2-6) battle the Washington Huskies (5-2) at Alaska Airlines Arena. Norfolk State seeks to snap a six-game skid following an 80-49 loss to NC State, while Washington has alternated wins and losses over its last four games.
